featured.title: The Servo Parallel Browser Engine Project
featured.description: Servo is a prototype web browser engine written in the Rust language. It is currently developed on 64-bit macOS, 64-bit Linux, 64-bit Windows, 64-bit OpenHarmony, and Android.

featured.title: motor-controller
featured.description: A generic, reusable WebView abstraction seam that lets any Rust desktop application embed Servo behind a strongly typed, engine-agnostic interface.
